model.title: Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Amendments Act of 2025
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Steve Daines (R-MT)

summary.text: The bill would amend a 2010 water rights settlement between the Crow Tribe of Montana and the state by making several administrative and financial changes to how two major water projects on the Crow Reservation are managed and funded. Specifically, it would establish separate accounts to support ongoing rehabilitation of the Crow Irrigation Project and development of the tribe's municipal and rural water system, and would extend the tribe's exclusive right to build hydropower facilities at Yellowtail Afterbay Dam by five years.
